units: normalized to the sprite canvas (0..1 across, 0..1 down)
note: Arms and hands in every view were traced to the arm's own outline (GrabCut seeded from a hand-placed shoulder-elbow-wrist-fingertip line, scripts/trace-arms.py with the skeletons in arms.json). 'fill' marks what a moved arm uncovers inside the figure. Heads, torsos and legs are still the automatic boxes.
